scenes.description: Hiking up a Green Mountain Trail with Tall Trees
A Sparkling Clean River Flowing through the Forest
Sunny Sandy Beach and Gentle Ocean Waves

character_line.en: Put on your hiking shoes! Let us climb up the green mountain!
character_line.zh: 穿上登山鞋！我們一起爬上這座綠油油的大山吧！

options.en: Let us hike to the top of the mountain!
options.zh: 我們一起健行爬到山頂吧！

options.hint: 爬山健行，可以用「hike to the top of the mountain」回答喔！
滿懷活力地跟 Benny 一起出發爬山吧！

character_line.en: The air is so fresh here in the tall pine forest!
character_line.zh: 高聳的松樹森林裡，空氣好清新喔！

options.en: The forest trees are so tall and green!
options.zh: 森林裡的樹木好高大好翠綠！

options.en: I sleep in the living room.
options.hint: 讚美森林裡的樹木，說「The forest trees are tall」！
深呼吸，享受森林芬多精的清新吧！

character_line.en: Listen! Can you hear the sound of flowing water?
character_line.zh: 聽！你有聽到潺潺的流水聲嗎？

options.en: Yes, there is a river next to us!
options.zh: 聽到了，我們身旁有一條小河！

options.hint: 流水潺潺的地方是一條「river」河流喔！

options.en: The book is in my bag.
options.hint: 跟著水聲走，發現清澈的小河流吧！

character_line.en: The river water is so clean! Look at the tiny fish!
character_line.zh: 河水好清澈喔！看那些小魚！

options.en: Little fish are swimming in the river!

options.hint: 看著小魚在小河游動，說「fish swimming in the river」！

options.en: My nose is on my face.
options.hint: 告訴 Benny 河水有多麼清涼純淨吧！

character_line.en: Now we have walked to the coast! Look at the yellow sand!
character_line.zh: 現在我們走到海岸邊了！看金黃色的沙灘！

options.en: We are at the sunny sandy beach!
options.zh: 我們來到陽光明媚的沙灘了！

options.hint: 海岸邊有沙子的地方是「beach」海灘喔！
脫下鞋子，踩在溫暖的金色沙灘上吧！

character_line.en: Look out at the deep blue sea! The waves are rolling in!
character_line.zh: 望向那片蔚藍的大海！海浪正一陣陣湧上來呢！

options.en: The blue sea and waves look magnificent!
options.zh: 蔚藍的大海與浪花看起來好壯觀！

options.hint: 欣賞遼闊的大海，說「The blue sea looks magnificent」！
跟 Benny 一起吹吹海風，欣賞壯麗海景吧！
